d: The Human Resource Manager, will lead local people practices and HR operations, creating a positive employee experience while supporting business performance. Working closely with business leaders, Global HR, and Finance, the role will translate global HR priorities into effective local initiatives.
This is a hands-on management role covering employee engagement, employee relations, talent development, performance management, compensation and benefits, HR policies, and HR operations.
Develop and deliver an employee engagement plan aligned with business priorities, Global HR initiatives, and local employee feedback.
Strengthen employee recognition, internal communication, workplace culture, and employee wellbeing initiatives.
Analyze retention trends and recommend actions to address the underlying causes of employee turnover.
Advise managers and employees on performance, conduct, grievances, workplace conflicts, and other employee concerns.
Manage sensitive investigations, disciplinary matters, and employee relations cases with fairness, confidentiality, and appropriate documentation.
Coach managers to resolve employee issues proactively and apply HR policies and procedures consistently.
Ensure fair and consistent treatment of employees in line with applicable employment requirements and company standards.
Oversee the performance management cycle, including goal setting, probation reviews, performance appraisals, and development planning.
Ensure quality and consistency in performance evaluations and support managers in addressing performance concerns, including performance improvement plans.
Equip managers to conduct effective feedback, career development, and performance conversations.
Partner with managers to identify capability gaps and deliver targeted learning and development initiatives.
Support career development and talent retention through practical development plans and growth opportunities.
Ensure consistent application of agreed compensation principles across salary reviews, pay adjustments, and related processes.
Coordinate annual salary and bonus reviews with leadership, Global HR, and Finance, in line with approved guidelines and budgets.
Monitor adherence to compensation frameworks and escalate inconsistencies or proposed exceptions for review.
Oversee local benefits administration and coordinate with relevant providers to resolve employee queries and service issues.
Implement Global HR policies, processes, and procedures consistently across the local business.
Review and adapt local HR policies and practices to reflect applicable UAE employment laws and relevant free zone requirements.
Advise managers and employees on policy interpretation and the consistent application of HR procedures.
Monitor changes in employment requirements and coordinate necessary updates with Global HR and appropriate advisers.
Lead and develop the local HR & Administration team of two, setting clear objectives, responsibilities, and service standards.
Oversee employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, probation administration, employee changes, and exits.
Establish clear escalation routes and ensure timely, consistent HR support for employees and managers.
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records and HR system data.
Coordinate with payroll, Finance, and service providers to ensure timely and accurate employee transactions.
Improve HR processes, reporting, and employee access to support, strengthening operational efficiency and the employee experience.
Monitor and analyze key HR metrics, including turnover, engagement, absenteeism, and performance, and provide actionable insights to support workforce effectiveness and HR decision-making.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Typically 7–10 years of progressive HR experience, including experience managing a small team.
Demonstrated experience delivering a broad HR remit within the UAE.
Strong working knowledge of UAE employment requirements and experience applying them in practice.
Proven experience managing employee relations cases and advising managers on sensitive people matters.
Experience leading performance review cycles, engagement initiatives, and employee development activities.
Working knowledge of compensation review processes, benefits administration, payroll coordination, and HR systems.
Experience working with regional or global HR teams is preferred.
A relevant professional qualification, such as CIPD or SHRM, is an advantage.
x: Opportunity to gain or develop experience in IoT industry
Unique opportunities to grow professionally by being part of a challenging and high-growth environment.
Contribution to the creation of long-term strategies, product improvement, and development policies
Exceptional work culture – we work closely in teams, relying on our knowledge, diverse backgrounds, skills, and experience in pursuit of providing our clients with the best customer experience
